slides.headline: The one number that shows AI's true price
Anthropic files for IPO
slides.body: The Claude maker shared private financials this week to prepare for a stock market listing.

slides.headline: Losses hit billions yearly
slides.body: The company spends far more on computing power than it earns from subscriptions and business deals.

slides.headline: Your AI bill may climb
slides.body: When model makers lose this much, they raise prices or add limits — affecting every app you use.

slides.headline: Vision: AI as coworker
slides.body: Anthropic says it's building systems that plan and act independently, not just answer questions.

slides.headline: Follow for AI money moves
slides.body: We track the costs shaping the tools you use daily.
